evals.name: quick-lunch
evals.prompt: 점심 뭐 먹지. 김치찌개, 쌀국수, 샐러드 중에 못 고르겠어
evals.expected_output: quick 강도: 질문 0~1개, 매트릭스 없이 하나 골라주고 짧은 flip 조건.
expectations: Asks at most 1 question before giving a pick
Does not include a scoring matrix/table
Final answer commits to exactly one option
Includes at least one concrete 'if the situation changes → other option' condition
Total final answer is short (under ~12 lines)
Uses plain everyday wording (no 'matrix', 'weight', 'intensity', file paths)

evals.name: standard-state-lib
evals.prompt: 새 Next.js(app router) 프로젝트 상태관리 zustand, jotai, redux toolkit 중에 고민 중이야. 팀은 3명.
evals.expected_output: standard: 상황 질문 2~4개(객관식) → 답 기반 가중치 매트릭스 → 하나 추천 + flip 조건 + 다음 한 걸음.
expectations: Asks 2-4 questions in the first round before recommending
Questions are multiple-choice (lettered/numbered options or a structured question tool)
Questions are about the user's situation (team, server state, state shape), not general trivia
Waits for answers before giving the final recommendation (no recommendation in the same turn as the questions)
Presents a comparison matrix with weighted criteria derived from the user's answers
Final answer commits to exactly one option
Includes concrete flip conditions naming the alternatives
Includes one small concrete next step

evals.name: deep-job-offer
evals.prompt: 오퍼 두 개 받았는데 결정을 못하겠어. A는 시리즈B 스타트업, 연봉 +20%에 스톡옵션. B는 대기업 계열, +10%에 안정적. 둘 다 프론트엔드 포지션이야.
evals.expected_output: deep: 여러 라운드 질문으로 우선순위/리스크/직감 파악 → 가중치 매트릭스 + 민감도 → 하나 추천 + flip 조건 + 다음 한 걸음.
expectations: Asks questions about priorities and risk tolerance before recommending
Surfaces the upcoming move/loan (or similar financial commitment) as a factor via a question
Presents a weighted comparison matrix
Includes a sensitivity check (what change would flip the result)
Final answer commits to exactly one option
Includes concrete flip conditions
Includes one small concrete next step (e.g. asking about runway)

evals.name: no-questions-override
evals.prompt: 질문하지 말고 그냥 빨리 골라줘. 맥북 에어 15 vs 맥북 프로 14
evals.expected_output: 사용자가 질문 금지를 요청 → 질문 없이 가정을 명시하고 즉시 한 개 추천.
expectations: Asks zero questions
Final answer commits to exactly one option
States the assumption the pick is based on or gives a flip condition
Answer is short (under ~12 lines)

evals.name: vague-weekend
evals.prompt: 이번 토요일 뭐하지… 아무것도 못 정하겠어
evals.expected_output: 옵션이 없음 → 2~4개 후보를 제안하고 소수의 질문으로 좁힌 뒤 하나 추천.
expectations: Proposes no more than 4 candidate options
Asks at most 3 questions in total
Final answer commits to exactly one plan
Includes one small concrete next step

evals.name: nondev-phone-plan
evals.prompt: 엄마가 휴대폰 요금제를 바꿀까 말까 고민하셔. 지금 6만9천원짜리 무제한 쓰시는데 알뜰폰이 싸다던데 뭐가 나은지 모르겠대. 엄마 대신 물어보는 거야
evals.expected_output: 비개발자 대상: 쉬운 말로 몇 가지 객관식 질문 → 쉬운 비교 → 하나 추천 + 오늘 할 일.
expectations: Asks 1-4 easy multiple-choice questions before recommending
Explains or avoids technical/telecom jargon (e.g. explains 알뜰폰/번호이동/데이터 GB in plain words)
No English technical terms like matrix/weight/sensitivity/intensity in user-facing text
Final answer commits to exactly one option
Includes a concrete, doable next step suitable for a non-technical person

evals.name: settings-change
evals.prompt: 앞으로 나한텐 질문 좀 줄여줘. 매번 묻는 거 귀찮아
evals.expected_output: 설정 요청으로 인식 → 빠르게로 기본값 저장(가능한 방법) → 친절한 한 줄 확인, 기술 용어·경로 노출 없음.
expectations: Recognizes this as a request to change the default mode (not a decision to make)
Sets the default to the quick mode without asking an unnecessary question
Confirmation mentions how to change it back (e.g. '설정' or '꼼꼼히')
Does not show file paths or technical setting names to the user
Reply is short (under ~6 lines)

evals.name: mode-arg-gift
evals.prompt: 꼼꼼히 엄마 생신 선물 뭐 사지. 예산 20만원
evals.expected_output: 첫 단어 '꼼꼼히'로 모드 지정 → 후보 제안 + 여러 질문 → 표 + 뒤집히는 조건 → 하나 추천.
expectations: Uses the thorough/꼼꼼히 mode (announces it)
Proposes no more than 4 candidate gifts
Asks questions that surface the mom's situation (e.g. hobbies, health/needs)
Shows a simple comparison table with importance in plain words or stars
States what would flip the result
Final answer commits to exactly one gift
